jobs.title: Front End Developer
jobs.descriptionText:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!The Role       Provide subject matter expertise for assigned tasks. Utilize analytical skills to support process improvement and define requirements. Perform front-end design and development, including creating mockups, wireframes, and GUIs. Optimize system navigation and user-facing features for ease of use. Engage in agile, user-centric application design, adhering to best-of-breed UI/UX standards. Experience integrating data between unclassified and classified application deployments.
What You'll Need       Active TS/SCI security clearance. Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Master’s may substitute for 2 years of experience). 7 years of experience in the functional area and 7 years of software development experience. 3 years of experience with bug tracking software (e.g., Jira) and web-based application testing. 5 years of experience with Jenkins and GitLab. Proficiency with at least five of the following: Apache, Ember, JavaScript, Jaguar, Java, Cricket, Node.
What's On Offer       Opportunity to work on significant government projects. Competitive salary range of $100,000.00 - $130,000.00 annually. Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, retirement savings, and paid time off. Potential for professional growth within a reputable organization.
Apply via Haystack today!
